title: Contributing to elodea
text: Fork package clone onto computer. haven’t done , recommend using usethis::create_from_github("onestop-project/elodea", fork = TRUE). Install development dependencies devtools::install_dev_deps(), make sure package passes R CMD check running devtools::check(). R CMD check doesn’t pass cleanly, ’s good idea ask help continuing. Create Git branch pull request (PR). recommend using usethis::pr_init("brief-description--change"). Make changes, commit git, create PR running usethis::pr_push(), following prompts browser. title PR briefly describe change. body PR contain Fixes #issue-number. user-facing changes, add bullet top NEWS.md (.e. just first header). Follow style described https://style.tidyverse.org/news.html.

title: Clean and Standardise Published GBIF Checklists
text: elodea can get taxonomic distribution information published GBIF checklist. get source taxa distributions Global Register Introduced Invasive Species - Monaco. can filter/standardise taxa distributions filter_data(), return list three data frames: taxa, distributions notes. first two data frames filtered taxa distributions, notes data frame contains information filtering process. Check filter_data() filter details. notes can help improve source checklist. standardised taxa distribution data can used build unified checklists combining multiple checklists single checklist.

title: Filter data — filter_data
text: Filters taxa distributions data frames, returns filtered data notes.

title: Filter data — filter_data
text: taxa Data frame returned get_taxa(). distributions Data frame returned get_distributions(). establishment_means EstablishmentMeans filter . taxa matching distributions establishmentMeans vector retained. Default "introduced".

title: Filter data — filter_data
text: list three data frames: taxa: Filtered taxa data frame, different columns input taxa data frame. distributions: Filtered distributions data frame. notes: Data frame notes taxa included replaced filtered data.

title: Filter data — filter_data
text: Defaults NULL, means filter establishmentMeans. Possible values "native", "introduced", "nativeReintroduced", "introducedAssistedColonisation", "vagrant", "uncertain" "nativeEndemic".

title: Filter data — filter_data
text: Taxa removed matched GBIF backbone (.e., nubKey NA), matching distribution (.e., taxonKey distributions$taxonKey), matching distribution establishmentMeans establishment_means. Synonyms replaced accepted taxa synonyms (.e., taxonomicStatus either "synonym", "ambiguous synonym", "heterotypic synonym", "homotypic synonym", "misapplied" "proparte synonym). scientificName replaced scientific name matching GBIF backbone.

title: Filter data — filter_data
text: taxa data frame output list 6 variables: taxonKey: GBIF taxon key scientificName. value replaced acceptedKey taxon synonym accepted taxon. nubKey: GBIF backbone taxon key. taxonID: Taxon ID scientificName, provided checklist. scientificName: Scientific name taxon. value replaced acceptedName records. kingdom: Kingdom taxon. taxonRank: Taxonomic rank taxon.

title: Get taxa from checklist — get_taxa
text: Gets taxonomic information GBIF checklist matching GBIF backbone taxonomy. source taxa kept, denormed higher classification taxa removed. function rgbif::name_usage() used hood.

title: Get taxa from checklist — get_taxa
text: datasetKey GBIF dataset key.

title: Get taxa from checklist — get_taxa
text: tibble taxonomic information dataset.

title: Get taxa from checklist — get_taxa
text: get_taxa() returns tibble 8 columns: taxonKey: GBIF taxon key scientificName. nubKey: GBIF backbone taxon key taxonID: Taxon ID scientificName, provided checklist. scientificName: Original scientific name taxon checklist. taxonomicStatus: Taxonomic status taxon GBIF backbone taxonomy. can accepted, synonym, doubtful NA taxon matched backbone. acceptedKey: GBIF taxon key accepted taxon, source scientificName synonym. acceptedName: Scientific name accepted taxon. scientificName accepted name GBIF backbone. acceptedKingdom: Kingdom accepted taxon. acceptedTaxonRank: Taxonomic rank accepted taxon.

title: elodea (development version)
text: get_taxa() now returns taxonomic status GBIF backbone taxonomy (taxonomicStatus), status source checklist (#19). columns accepted, kingdom, taxonRank replaced acceptedName, acceptedKingdom acceptedTaxonRank. filter_data() now returns fewer columns, new argument establishment_means allows custom filtering taxa based establishmentMeans (e.g. native, introduced), instead built-filtering “introduced” taxa (#19, #24). get_distributions() now returns verbatim distributions (#30).

title: elodea 0.1.0
text: New function get_taxa() gets taxa GBIF checklist (#4). New function get_distributions() gets distributions GBIF checklist (#4). New function filter_data() filters taxa distributions, returns notes describing taxa removed (#4).
